summary: Frontend-only verification of daily-summary widget fix on Dashboard (index.tsx). All bug-fix scenarios and regression checks PASSED. Forward arrow (btn-day-next) is no longer disabled and works in both directions including into future dates. Today quick-jump button (btn-day-today) is correctly hidden when on today and visible otherwise. Timezone-safe local-date logic verified (label 'TODAY — FRI, JUL 17'). Dashboard hero now shows 'NET PROFIT' with new testID 'dashboard-net-profit'; legacy 'dashboard-net-worth' no longer present. Opening/Closing/Net Worth footer renders correctly. Bottom tabs (Bills, Partners, Reports, Settings) navigate cleanly. Voice modal opens. Zero runtime/page errors detected; only benign RN-Web deprecation warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Non-blocking but should migrate to boxShadow for RN 0.75+ web compatibility.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking; consider moving pointerEvents into style prop.

action_items: (Optional/non-blocking) Migrate deprecated 'shadow*' style props to 'boxShadow' and move 'pointerEvents' prop into style to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx (340 lines) is approaching the 700-line soft limit — still fine, but future feature growth on the Dashboard should be split into sub-components (e.g., DailySummaryCard, ProfitFlowCard).
shiftDay and localTodayStr are correctly using local timezone. The useEffect on dailyDate is correct and prevents stale data. Implementation matches PR description.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dashboard daily-summary fix verified end-to-end on mobile viewport (390x844). Testable via btn-day-prev / btn-day-next / btn-day-today / btn-share-daily testIDs. Hero uses dashboard-net-profit testID. No backend calls were re-tested since this fix is frontend-only.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: forward arrow was disabled via `disabled={isToday}` combined with `dailyDate` initialized in UTC (toISOString) while shiftDay used local-time. In non-UTC timezones, isToday could become permanently false or the arrow could disable prematurely. Fix in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx: (1) localTodayStr() helper builds YYYY-MM-DD from local Date parts; (2) shiftDay reconstructs via local components; (3) forward arrow no longer carries disabled prop; (4) Today quick-jump button rendered conditionally; (5) useEffect([dailyDate]) triggers reload without needing screen refocus. All verified working.
